ratings_why.fun: Three builds that pull one dial three ways, and the cards read as the fantasy (eggs in hosts, dormice asleep in jars), but six keywords is a heavy load and much of the growth lives only inside fights.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because no tribe today puts its own units inside the opponent's line-up: a Chick hatching in the enemy's row and hitting their back row is a new picture on the board, and the shared fight clock is new too.

verdict_why: The cards mostly read cleanly now; one rule gap (Ottilie dying mid-fight) and the full-board Chick case are worth one more pass.

points.text: Grand Horologe Ottilie Gugger doesn't say what happens to the pace if she dies mid-fight, or how ticks already counted carry over. Say whether the clock goes back to every 3rd tick and from which count.

The Egg build is told to strike the 1st hour during Start of Combat, but late-game boards are full then, so the Chick lands on your side and the cuckoo-in-the-nest picture is lost. Consider letting a hatching Chick push into the host's slot area (or replace the heaved host) so the fantasy holds on full boards.
Brood is a second counter on top of the clock and only Egg-Painter raises it; folding it into Egg-Painter's own text (or showing it on the Egg marker) would cut one keyword from the reading load.
Little Gernegroß reads at a glance and is the whole joke in one card: a chick the host's size that at once hits its foster parent. Keep it as the tribe's poster card.

standouts.why: Little Gernegroß: copy the biggest enemy, then it hits its host; the seed's joke in one line.
Seven-Sleeper: grows only if never needed, so it argues with your own Wind; simple text, real tension.
Sleeping-Vault Warden: guards any tribe's engine, a clean reason to mix in a lobby.

weakest.why: Day-Wage Journeyman: plain gold card whose payout depends on last fight's hour count, which is hard to predict or feel.
Coin-Turner: banked gold into Wind is a nice folklore nod but a quiet enabler with no picture of its own.
Mother Rohrsang: a generic Chick buff that doesn't use her foster-mother story (insisting he takes after her).

flags.note: Pace after Ottilie dies mid-fight is not written.
Doorkeeper with golden Ottilie doubles every hour effect at a faster pace; caps hold it, but worth the owner's eye.
Copies a golden carry's full stats plus Brood; the design's own risk list names it.
